name: no-database
description: Remove PostgreSQL, Drizzle, and Better Auth persistence.

edits.find:
# If 5432 is taken on your machine, change DB_PORT and the port in DATABASE_URL together.
DB_PORT=5432
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/app

# Any random string >= 32 chars. Generate a real one for production: `openssl rand -hex 32`
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=dev-only-secret-change-me-please-really
BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000
edits.replace:
# API key accepted by the no-database auth stub for server-to-server requests.
API_KEY=dev-only-api-key

edits.find:
# PostgreSQL connection string reachable from the runtime platform. sslmode=no-verify encrypts
# the connection without verifying the server; set DATABASE_CA_CERT below to verify it.
DATABASE_URL=postgres://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DATABASE?sslmode=no-verify

# Optional CA certificate (base64) for databases with a private CA, e.g. IBM Cloud Databases.
# See docs/deploy-code-engine.md#database-tls.
# DATABASE_CA_CERT=

# Generate a real secret with: openssl rand -hex 32
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=replace-with-at-least-32-random-characters

# Public origin of the deployed app, without a trailing slash. Deploy scripts derive it
# automatically when left on this example value.
BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://cen-starter.example.com

# Migrations auto-apply at boot in production. Set to "false" to manage them manually.
# MIGRATE_ON_START=false
edits.replace:
# API key accepted by the no-database auth stub. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32
API_KEY=replace-with-a-real-api-key

edits.find:
validation_problems=()

# Flavors extend production-env validation here (the oauth-proxy flavor checks IdP values).
validate_flavor_env() {
  :
}

validate_production_env() {
  local ca_cert=""
  local sslmode=""
  local problem=""
  local index=1

  database_url=$(env_file_value DATABASE_URL "$ENV_FILE" || true)

  if [[ -z "$database_url" || "$database_url" == "postgres://USER:PASSWORD@HOST"* ]]; then
    validation_problems+=("DATABASE_URL is missing or still the example value; set a PostgreSQL connection string reachable from Code Engine (IBM Cloud Databases for PostgreSQL is the usual choice).")
  elif [[ "$database_url" == *databases.appdomain.cloud* ]]; then
    # IBM Cloud Databases uses a private CA and node-postgres verifies by default, so a
    # verifying sslmode without a CA dies at boot with SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN.
    ca_cert=$(env_file_value DATABASE_CA_CERT "$ENV_FILE" || true)
    if [[ -z "$ca_cert" ]]; then
      sslmode=$(printf '%s' "$database_url" | sed -n 's/.*[?&]sslmode=\([^&]*\).*/\1/p')
      case "$sslmode" in
        no-verify | disable) ;;
        *)
          validation_problems+=("DATABASE_URL points at IBM Cloud Databases with sslmode=${sslmode:-<unset>} but DATABASE_CA_CERT is empty, so the app would fail to boot with SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN. Either change sslmode to no-verify (encrypted, server not verified), or keep it and set DATABASE_CA_CERT: ibmcloud cdb deployment-cacert ICD_INSTANCE_NAME > icd-ca.pem && base64 < icd-ca.pem | tr -d '\n' (replace ICD_INSTANCE_NAME; list instances with: ibmcloud resource service-instances --service-name databases-for-postgresql).")
          ;;
      esac
    fi
  fi

  validate_flavor_env

  if ((${#validation_problems[@]} == 0)); then
    return 0
  fi

  error "$ENV_FILE is not ready to deploy:"
  for problem in "${validation_problems[@]}"; do
    error "  ${index}. $problem"
    index=$((index + 1))
  done
  if ! configured_iam_api_key >/dev/null; then
    error "note: the first deploy also needs an IBM Cloud API key to create the registry secret."
    error "      Run ./deploy/create-deploy-key.sh to create and store one without displaying it,"
    error "      or configure IBMCLOUD_API_KEY / IAM_API_KEY. Later deploys reuse the secret."
  fi
  exit 1
}

# Keep migration SQL available without shipping Drizzle tooling or app source.
RUN rm -rf /app/backend-prod/src /app/backend-prod/drizzle.config.ts /app/backend-prod/tsconfig.json \
  && mkdir -p /app/backend-prod/src/db \
  && cp -R /app/backend/src/db/migrations /app/backend-prod/src/db/migrations
